label: Wind power class 1
definition: NREL wind power class 1 (poor), corresponding to a wind power density of 0–200 W/m² at 50 m above ground.
comment: The NREL wind power classes rank sites from 1 (poor) to 7 (superb) by their mean wind power density, as a quick indicator of the suitability of a site for wind energy.
